Large transport advance and release at899, but outside bucket footprint; no stable60

secondary_new_case.interpretation: New near-bucket held transport, followed by drifting away; not strict

limitations: auxiliary strict regresses1/2→0/2; single historical scene, secondary evidence
2012485 loses stable grasp, 2014362 gains it; totalheld/detach7/8 unchanged
No claims that training dose explains all failures
15cm bucket-neighborhood is a passive diagnostic, not a new success gate

protocol.acceptance: same planned fruit held15 -> detached -> release -> unheld in strict bucket60; no breaks/incidental detach/base drift/numerical failure; all accepted trajectories oracle replay PASS
protocol.anchor_rule: 0..min(29,num_frames-30), frame0 included; full30 next measured-state labels

mining_rules.R1: no held; planned apple attached; TCP distance <=0.09m and closing intent or finger contact; best contact/geometry candidate per episode
mining_rules.R2: same planned apple held >=15 boundaries, detached preferred, >0.25m bucket distance; earliest stable transport boundary
mining_rules.R3: same detached fruit held >=15; predicted imminent sustained open away from bucket OR >=350 steps with progress over previous60 steps <0.03m; never duplicate R2 step

protocol.bounded_source_rule: deterministic original B cohort order, protected scenes removed; initial4 then at most36 seed42 scenes; seed43 only for missing categories; max2 candidates/category/source for retries, no quota-driven gate changes
protocol.revision: R retry2: retain true takeover anchors plus sparse teacher-continuation bridge windows from existing live-state recovery trajectories. Student onset and teacher continuation are separately reported; no new rejected on-policy records are used.
